This directory contains the shared browser runtime files used by the PCIbex
example execution smoke tests.

Source: the standalone IBEX bundle supplied for this project, whose upstream
project is https://github.com/addrummond/ibex. The supplied bundle did not
include its upstream Git revision metadata, so the checked-in files themselves
are the exact runtime snapshot used by CI.

The runtime files are distributed under the BSD license reproduced in LICENSE.
The PennController scripts are provided by the example ZIP fixtures, not copied
into this directory.
